entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Tikotamise tose musoro yedu. Hanzi, “Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Rangu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Ini ndiripowo ipapo.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “…Munhu wese ngaave murevi wenhema, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] asi Mwari vave murevi wezvokwadi…” [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Dai Mwari vaitiitira nyasha, muzuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muzuva ranhasi, rive zuva ravanotaura newe. [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Baba tinokutendai manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokutendai nekunaka kwenyu mukati memba ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokutendai nehukuru hwenyu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] Baba hwamakaratidza pakati pedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari mumwe nemumwe ari mukati memba ino tariro yake iri kwamuri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba dai maswededza chipfuva chimwe nechimwe kwamuri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuuya kuChechi hakuna kukwana, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] asi kusandurwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dai Mwari taigowanikwa Ishe tichiponeswa, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] taburitswa kumweya wenyika, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kana kuyemura zvinhu zvemo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiitirei ngoni kumazuva ano ekupedzisira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Baba makanaka pindirai pakunamata kwedu pazuva ranhasi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chionai mumwe nemumwe auya pano Baba wakanaka. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ishe dai anga akakwana asipo pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Dai anga asingadi kukunamatai asipo pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Asi mumwe nemumwe auya pano nekuti vanoda kukunamatai. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tidaireiwo pamuteuro wedu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda kuwanikwa Baba tiri vana venyu vamunofarira. [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Chivai nemumwe nemumwe mukati memba ino. Kuguma kwokushumaira kwezuva ranhasi, tipe mbiri nekukudzwa kuZita Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda iyoyi nguva yatiri kupuhwa nemi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda nerugare rwatiri kuwana kuti tinyengetere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Totenda netariro yemusangano watinawo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tariro yedu iri kwamuri manheru ano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taikumbira izvi nokutenda, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tigare tese pasi.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu kuva zvakare muimba yaMwari, tichingoti dai Mwari vaitiitira nyasha. Tokwazisa hama dzese dzauya nhasi, ahh Pastor Makaza, Brother Lloyd, ahh everyone va… vauya nhasi, ehh Brother Nyabeza handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tine mufaro kuva nemi mese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndofunga tatouya kumusangano wedu wamangwana, ehh rinova zuva guru kwatiri chai...? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “chaizvo."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then toda kuti ti-tirangarire Sister… Nehohwa naSister Ka- nana Sister Kadzirange vese vari vaviri nekuti amai vavo vashaya. Vaya vatakambouya tikanamatira panapa handiti. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Saka tatichifunga kuti pamwe kuda vanovigwa anytime this holiday but tanzwa naBrother Nehohwa kuti maybe mutumbi unouya Thursday handiti…? Mmm. So, let's remember that family in prayer. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, remember vakanga vaenda na-na… mai vavo kuSouth Africa, vachida kuti vanorapiwa, then she passed away th-this morning handiti. Mmm, we are really sorry for… for that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Maona, vanga vari mbuya vedu. Tatichingoti dai Mwari avaitira chii…? [Congregation says, “nyasha,”] nyasha, ehe vararama mukunamata kwakanaka nhaika...?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] hatinyengetererei musangano wedu. Tine musangano mangwana but it looks like we are going to have it, hatichaitira pamba. Hama dzakwanisa kuti dzironge kuti tiite paHallingbury apa. Saka, ndopa tinoitira ma service edu. Saka after the service today maybe the officers, kana vangobva kunonamatira… ma parents angu kuda togara pasi handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Tonyatsoronga how it's supposed to be done. So, if the officers would not just rush away even, nema song leaders tigonyatsorongana zvakanaka. Touya togara imo munomu tonyatsoronga food, cooking, sleeping handitika. Yevanhu. Hatiregere kuita arouse suspicion yema- neighbours handitika. Tizviite zvakanaka. Kubika kwacho mangwana, madyiro acho kuti vanhu vachadyira kupi, then marariro acho ticharonga sei? Handitika? Then ma items edu maitiro edu because hakuzi kwedu kwatajaira. So we need to do things on ti...? [Congregation says, “on time,"] on time.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuitira kuti tikaita two hours, two hours tabuda. Then, towana nguva yekudya. Then so it will be Monday, ahhh Saturday. Mangwana totanga- we have the place from ten to... to six. Saka, hama dzinogona kunge dzatovapo zvadzo kuma twelve iii one tichimirira kupinda handitika. Then on Sunday, panoita vamwe vanopindapo, ndopatichaita service yemanheru between five and ni- [Apostle Gumbura knocks on the pulpit three-times] and nine on uhhh Sunday.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then on Monday, another ten to...? [Congregation says, “six,"] to six. Then on uhhh Tuesday, ten to one handitika. Saka tobva tapedza. So, that's where we'll have our services, throught the… period handitika. Saka chatichangoronga chatichada kuti tizo announ-tsa neSaturday handitika, madyiro eva...? Evanhu. Nemarariro avachaita, I think the brothers we'll sit down and come up with a plan handitika. Yatinobvumirana tose, handitika. Then we convey it.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then we want our items to.... do our items nicely, so that tinozowana ma videos ane nziyo dzevatendi. So, we have about ten to six. Saka tikatanga na 1:30, kuimba handitika. We can have time nema item, time yema specials songs inosvika almost about an hour, then yatinogona kuzoita ma videos handitika. Aozoshandisa, because togona kuimba from 1:30 maybe to 2:30 handitika. Or 1:30 to 2:30, 2:30 to 3 o'clock worship. Then totanga kuparidza na three handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Tikatanga kuparidza na3, 5 o'clock or 5:30 tapedza.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then todya, vanhu voenda vonodii...? Vonozorora handitika. Todaro futi the following day like that, we make nice arrangements. Let's make a program for every day. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, then it be specific handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Let's make a program for every day. Madyiro edu, nguva dzedu dzokudya, then let's try to adhere to that. Then ndofunga kuti it will be less strenuous than we were anticipating handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] So, let's pray for that uhhh during this Heroes pe...? period ha-maona ngatinyengetererei.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then, handei mberi nekunamatira zvikumbiro zvedu zvatiri kutsanyira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tine zvatiri kutsanyira zuva rimwe nei...? [Congregation says, “nerimwe,"] nerimwe. We have to achieve our goals in prayer, we have to achieve our goals. Hanzi, "...gugudza [Apostle Gumbura knocks on the pulpit several-times] unodii...? [Congregation says, ‘unozarurirwa,'] tsvaka unoita sei...? [Congregation says, ‘unowana,'] kumbira unodii...?'' [Congregation says, “unopihwa."] "...regai munhu wese ave murevi we...? [Congregation says, ‘wenhema,'] Mwari Vave murevi [Apostle Gumbura knocks on the pulpit six times] we...? [Congregation says, ‘wezvokwadi,'] wezvokwadi..." We are looking forward to God answering our prayers, handiti. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then tagara tine muteuro yatinogara tichipa, tichinamatirawo vanorwara handitika. Hatiregererei kukanganwa handitika. Brother Zimbiti vaifara fani, mwana wavo akaita nane, ahh zvikuru tinotenda minamato yevatsvene. Now let's remember those brothers from South Africa neBotswana vari ku travell-a vachidii...? [Congregation says “vachiuya,”] vachiuya, nhasi handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Tivaise pamberi paMwari mui...? [Congregation says, “mumunamato,"] mumunamato kuti vafambe nenyasha.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then let’s pray for the Word that we will feed on, kuti Mwari vatiitire chii...? [Congregation says, “nyasha,”] nyasha. Then above all tiri kunamatira one accord. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] This is one accord between husband and...? [Congregation says, “wife."] One accord between husband and wife ha-maona, wife and husband in one accord. Then we want one accord in the Church. Then we want one accord with everybody ha-maona. Totokumbira pamuteuro, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti Mwari vatiitire chii...? [Congregation says, “nyasha,”] nyasha handimoona. Mwari vanoita ngoni haikona zvekutamba. [Congregation says, “Amen/mmm."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Totenda Mwari Brother Kudzai vangadei vakafa last Sunday naBrother Obvious. Vakaita car accident yanga iri serious pakatofa vanhu five. Vamwe vaitotakurwa vachifira mumota, but hama yakangokuvara back, Brother Obvious havana kutombokuvara ha-moona. Handimoona kuti munamato unokosha chaizvo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We could be talking about another thing now, about that brother handi maona...? Or about both brothers! Saka Mwari vakaita chii...? [Congregation says, “nyasha,”] nyasha handimaona. Saka, hatinyengetereranei chaizvo kuti ti…fambe zvakanaka paHeroes apa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Heroes inoti netsei, hatifambei zvakadii...? Zvakanaka.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then toda kuti tive nenguva yakanaka muShoko raani...? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, “raMwari."] Hama dzofamba, torara tichizorora. It will be strenuous during this particular period, a long period handiti. And it's the first time we are doing it here. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] We don't know how it wi… it would come out; the outcome is known after tapedza handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka ngatinyengeterei chaizvo handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ndotenda kuti Mwari vanopindira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Then, try and be as accommodative as possible kune vanenge vane vanhu mudzimba dzavo, [Congregation says, “mmm,”] and try and be as Christian as mu...? As possible moona. Kugara nevanhu, vamwe vanosiyana. Vamwe havazi that smart, vamwe havazi that ahh…ahh appreciative, vamwe havazi that good in communication. But the aim of the whole purpose is to pray, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] and to preach the...? [Congregation says, “Gospel."] Ehe.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Don’t get somebody whom you are compartible with and don't expect to, not to step toes, nguva yaunogara neva...? [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation say, "nevamwe."] So, most of the brothers in Harare are used to staying in other brothers' homes. They have never been recipients, you see. Now this time you are going to be what...? [Congregation says, “recipients,"] y-recipients handiti. And the houses will be full, ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: You will have your homes full, lounges, handitika. Ehh will be full, uhh sleep, to push-a [to push-ED] ma sofa zvatinoita ku Ridgemont zviya zviya handimaona. Some have never done that, but for these four days why, we should do that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] There is a cause, yekuti tinamate Mwari. [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukaona nyika chaiyo inotodaro. Muchaona even kuSouth Africa pa 2010 vamwe vanhu vano muvha out of their homes, vachiisa vanhu imo...? [Congregation says, “imomo."] We did it once here during the time of NUM/NAM, kukatozovakwa ma villas handiti you remember. [Congregation says, “mmm.] Ehe, it's their cause, the political cause. Vamwe vaifara kuti tiri kuchengeta ma delegates e ANC, tiri kuchengeta ma delegates eku Lybia, tiri kuchengeta ma delegates e kwakati. So, you take your cause, your cause is Christianity. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Tetichichengeta ma delegates ekudenga handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] So, some are not good people you know, this-th-th-that's the problem with Christianity.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Some are not good people, and they will never be. But vari kungopfura pano kuitira kuti kutongwa kwavo kudii...? Kuzadzikiswe handitika. Saka rega kuvapa room yekuti vanotaura poindi [point-ED] on the white great- on the white throne handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti munotoziva ndakauya inini but mai ava, vakamira munzira mangu zvekuti handina kuzoona kunaka kwaJesu kubva musi...? [Congregation says, “iwoyo,"] musi iwoyo. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] So, let's not do that handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Let's accommodate handitika. As much as possible nekuti vamwe vanhu shuwa vanongouya kuzongotiedza. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ehe, munovapa time, unovapa food yako, unovapa pekugara but there will never appreciate. I've always wondered. But when you go back to the Word of God, God talks about, but of the ten lepers, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] how many came to thank Him? [Congregation says, “one,"] one. Where did the nine go? They were talking rubbish. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] All the nine were talking rubbish, handimunoona zvinoiitika muhupenyu...? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe so, that's the same thing kana pakunamata. Mukagara nevanhu mudzimba dzenyu, don't expect kuti munhu wese achabva pamba ipapo achabva achitenda. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuona chakanaka chaunenge waitirwa, inyasha dzaani...? [Congregation says, “dzaMwari,"] dzaMwari. To say, 'thank you' does not come from intelligence, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Or understanding, if it's a heartfelt 'thanks', it's out of a heart that’s really appreciative. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Maona, saka not everybody is that he...? That's why we do services. We do services in all our life, but they might go unnoticed. [Congregation says, “mmm.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka makaona ndakataura kuti kunyangwe vari vanhu vemunyika vakaita sana Musika handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] We really appreciate those people. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha-maona. But do you know kune mumwe munhu anenge achitoti haana basa nemadhara aya ngaapere, rubbish, takuda zvinhu zvinyowani handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] You, see? Ndomaonero ake, [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] he does- he doesn't have an eye to see what contribution those people have, given, in your personal life. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But isu handimunoona tatova nema independent churches like this. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] 27Mmm, honai kwatava kugara. Lifestyle yakachinja chaizvo, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ne Independence. The kind of jobs you would get now, you wouldn't have gotten them then during the colonial era. And you need to go to Britain or A-America and find how difficult it is to get a job that you qualified for. Ehh bvunzai vana Sister Chipo ava, ma degree vanawo but kuti uwane basa rawakaendera kuchikoro it's very- it's im- almost clo- next to impossible. Hauriwane. Ndoinonzi racism in it's true co...? [Congregation says, “colours,"] colours handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But after Independence, look what we enjoyed. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Saka MDC, ZANU, ZAPU, vana Nkomo vaya, haaa zveshuwa ndivana umdala wethu. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ehe umdala...? [Congregation says, “dala wethu,"] dala wethu. Ukaona maNdevere achiti, “umdala wethu” kana iwe uri muShona unotoziva kuti shuwa, mudhara wedu, [Congregation chuckles] handimaoona. But kuti uti, “haaa, haazi mudhala wethu” because heee muNdevere haaa unenge uri zibenzi remunhu because that man suffered. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe murume uya akatambura uya. Vakapinda mu Gonakudzingwa, vakarohwa, vakarumiswa nembwa, vakadii but vachiti, 'nyika yedu'.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Isu tangovapo manje ku injoya [to enjoy-ED] nyika i...? [Congregation says, “iyoyo,"] nyika iya handi muri kuona. We are enjoying! Hee, we are really enjoying. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] Ehe kuti titi hatisi ku injoya ka ahh ahh ahh hatidi kunyeperana kudaro, after Independence everybody enjoyed. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I remember during the time when colonial era, vana baba vedu vaiti vakatenga tuma Anglia twemakotsi utwu, yaiita nyaya hombe chaizvo. Netwu motokari tumwe twainzi tuma Prefect. Then twuma Morris, handiti. Did we ever dream that a black man would drive a- a mac, would drive a 4x4, ehh would drive and stay in a double storey building? No. Taigara muma semi- detached houses handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ndozvatakakura tichiita.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Inini, I grew up in Alaska where we used a common toilet, and the toilet was fanga kune main house uko, ini ndiri kunoku. Ini ndiri kunoku imagine. So, you would wake up in the morning i-i… at night kana une manyoka handitika. [Congregation laughs] Kuti uende kutoireti iri kuzasi uko. And I know one time after, it was after Christmas vana mainini vangu vauya, vana Mai Bella. I remember that very well, ha-maona. Ndakazviitira kuzadza ma sheets ese, [Congregation laughs] kuzadza ma sheet, vanhu vakasuka ma sheets husiku na-na f-na two am. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mumba manga musisarasike... mamusararike manje uko because ndandanzwa… ku mess-a imba yose nekugutisa. [Apostle and Congregation laugh] But I know very well I was grown up, I was big, I don't think ehh kwakava kutadza kuzvi controll-a, hwaive hunyope hwokumuka kudi...? [Congregation laughs] Kwanga kune toireti kwaive kure. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] Zvosangana nehuhwana huduku, you messed up the whole thing, [Apostle Gumbura claps his hands once] ehh. Ndakarohwa zvokurohwa manheru iwayo, but nevertheless, vanhu kuwacha vakadii...? [Congregation laughing says, “vakawa...."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Now we are sleeping next door to our toilets handitika. ehe. We sleep just the next door is your toilet. So, nomatter how pressed you are, you can always go to the toilet. Ende iyoyo i Independence iyoyo. That was Alaska Mine. Right, then most of us went to school but I went to school in Alaska, then I went to school in Gweru but kuGweru ndakadzidza ku St Michaels, it was a Roman Catholic school.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Nobody would go to Chaplin; nobody would go to Thornhill. Zvazviri zvikoro zvevai...? [Congregation says, “zvevarungu,"] zvevarungu. So, you can... most of the youngsters vaiye zvino, they don't know what it is, kuti chinonzi Independance chii, ha-maona. Then we grew up not knowing what it is to eat a piece of meat. Kudya piece yakadai yenyama, nguva ye… Rhodesia? I-i-it wasn't normal. Taingodya sadza nemurimo une mabhonzo, mabhonzo anonhuwisa mm... muriwo kuti ungoita sekuti une nyama. Saka Mwari vakaita nyasha fani pa Independence. [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I really thank God, ha-moona, for the independence we received ha-moona. I really did because you become... any man now can yield his full pote...? [Congregation says, “potential.”] In the natural. In the natural if you are talented, you can yield your full potential because nothing sto- eh-eh-eh goes in your way, nothing ha-moona. The sky is the...? [Congregation says, “the limit."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Those who were entrepreneurs, could make millions ehh. Those who could run supermarkets, could run supermarkets. Those could run private hospitals, could run private hos-pitals. Those that could run private colleges could run private colleges. You could do anything. Those who wanted to be pilots could be pilots. You could be what you want. This is the blessing of natural independence, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] handitika. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But it's people like Nkomo, Mugabe, Musika handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: While we appreciate the new breed of of-of-of-of-of of politicians handitika. We never forget that they did not do nothing, for us ha-moona...? They will do something if they are given the cha...? [Congregation says, “the chance.”] But at the moment they did what...? [Congregation says, “nothing."] Those guys are criticizers, spectators, in a football game. But I don't know how he would perform if he is in the ground. [Apostle laughs] Nekuti ukaona madhara anotonga vanhu vanenge vapotsa ground ka vapotsa go-d-d-d ghedhe, zimadhara zvine dumbu kuti, 'mupfana indava kupusa so ahhh ungadei wagohwesa'. Iye haagone kusimudza gumbo rake. [Congregation laughs] It's so easy handitika. To do that to others handiti.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka makaona ini ndakazozvidzidziswa after ndaita muKristu, ndaita a pastor for years. When I heard people vamwe vandakaroorera vakadzi, unotoziva kuti murume uyu ka uyu vana vaanavo ava, if you were not in his life, he wouldn't ha...? [Congregation says, “have them."] Uchitomunzwa achikutuka kuti hauna zvawakamuitira muhupenyu, akabata mwana wacho mumaoko he-he-he-he. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] Then I understood ten lepers, I did. Kuti ahhh this guy is mad mmm?' Gumbura ngaafe, Gumbura ngaadaiwo'. Ahh. Woshaya kuti ko murume uyo, would send his children to school, I'm not his brother in the natural.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)

entries.text: One of them kuoma. Ndozviziva kuti ndakaoma sterek, but ndokwandaka zvidi ikoko…? Handitogoniwo hand...dai ndai… Handitozive kuti ndopfava sei? entries.text: Ndanga ndiri chipanera. Ezvino munoti ndakaoma. Ahhh “…my little finger shall be thicker than my father’s waist.” [Congregation laughs] Ahhh! Asingaite.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then vakadzi vaine pamuviri tanga tisinganzwisisi. Takanetsa mukadzi waaa Brother…? [Bro Makaza says, ‘‘Kaseke.’’] Kaseke aine nhumbu, imi kaimi. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Taidzidziswa izvozvo but as time goes on uchiramba uchiverenga Spoken Word neBhaibheri, Mweya waMwari wakauya! Forty days, thirty days, twenty-nine days, ten days, fifteen days; ndomatsanyiro edu.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Takazoti taverenga Bhuku rinonzi, Enticing spirits takaona kuti handii…? [Congregation says, ‘‘handizvo.’’] Haaah! Ini zvababa vaya I’ve had enough of him. [Congregation laughs] I’ve had enough of him. Mwari ngavandiregerere ipapo. I’ve just had enough of him ha-moona ehe. I’ve just had enough of him, ha-moona! Hameno zvavo vasinga mudii…? entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndopakapinzwa vana Sister Vimbai ava, Gumbura ava ikokoko. Vana Sister ehh… Munaki, Patricia Munaki vana andi-i-andi-i the list is endless. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Do you know why? Why? Why would a man refuse serpent what…? [Congregation says, “seed."] Ndopa ndakabata chizaruro changu ipapo. Ehe, iwe kana uri munhu woMweya unochibata futi ipapo. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Why would a man refuse serpent seed, hamuona? Ndopandakabata chinhu one kuti aiwa i-nga-ngatingosiyanai nazvo zvinhu izvi.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: If a man couldn’t see serpent seed ka, I can’t see him achiona Marriage and what…? [Congregation says, “and Divorce."] It’s impossible! It’s just literally, practically impossible. Ende muchaona kuti as he realises his more threatened than what he thought, the persecution gets grea…? [Congregation says, “greater,"] greater.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Iye zvino the hatred is serious. Iri pa level yekuti tichahayirwa ma assassins ha-maona. Because he has taken as many people as he has wanted, but the Church has never f… closed or folded up and that’s worrying him. He thought by that move, Chechi yekuno ichavha…? [Congregation says, “ichavhara."] Vanhu vachienda kwaani…? [Congregation says, “kwaari."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndichingopinda muHarare Mwari avakufumura ivo manje, kutotisimbisa ku…? [Congregation says, “kuno."] Hatinyengeterei varanda vaMwari [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Change of status iyi ka iyi, kwandiri inini it’s a ni- it’s a matter of survival. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatidi kugara zvinonzwisa tsitsi muno muHarare. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndinoaziva mafangiro ani…? [Congregation says, “avo,"] avo. Would be called every name known. KuGweru we could do with anything. Munomu ka umu tino inva-dwa even one day, nema-nema nhingi, nema paid up reporters. But I want him to come handitika. Vanhu vomuno muHarare, vanhu venyama vanoremekedza zvinhu zvenya…? [Congregation says, “zvenyama."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe ndoda kuti vachisvika, vakasvika vakaona kunenge kwakarara ma brother acho, havana chananodii…? Chavanosvora. Vakasvika vakaona patinodyira… All I’m doing this; I’m preparing for a war because I know one day that war will go public. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende anotitengesa public vamwe ve….? [Congregation says, “vedu."] Vamwe vedu ma brothers aya.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ichabuda chete nyaya one day sometime kunzi, ‘endai munoona magariro aanoita nevasikana vaanogara navo nevakamana vaanogara navo. You will wake up one morning muchizviverenga. But I want that time when it does come, Mwari vakatipa warning ka…? [Congregation says, “kare, Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I don’t want to be caught unawares like I don’t know what I’m doing. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handidi! Ndoda kunyatsomeka shuwa, ha-maona, kuti kana vakauya vakandiwanira mhosva ngavandiwanirowo dzimwe. But magariro ande ndakaita whether ndine vana forty, magariro anenge akaita vana ivavo even the best schools; private schools don’t look after children that way. [Congregation says, “Amen."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: We don’t leave no stene untorned panyaya iyi! Ndosaka kuteura kwandiri kuita ka uku, ndiri kuteura ndakatarisana nekuziva kuti we have plenty enemies in here. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ma enemies acho akadii…? [Congregation says, “Akawanda”.] Akawanda vanhu vaMwari. Akawandisa ma enemies acho! Hazvipe-haapere ha-moona, ndosaka ndoda kuti brother vamwe nevamwe vati, ‘Mwari status yangu ngaisanduke.’ [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndoda kuva nemari, Mwari tsurai mweya yemai…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza, Amen."] Mwari tsurai mweya yemadzinza. Mwari tsurai kusanamata. Mwari tsurai hudheni. Mwari tsurai, mweya yetsvina.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndosaka ma sisters edu ndapota vana vaMwari rega kuunza mweya wetsvina muKereke! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mudzimai wese ane potential yekuunza mweya wetsvina muKereke kana akadanana nemunhu wemui…? [Congregation says, “wemunyika."] Muri kupanzwisisa ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopanonzi, “God’s word calls for total…?” [Congregation says, “separation.”] Ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukadzi wese akadanana nemunhu wemunyika unounza spirit pa Church, yeku rebel-a kuShoko raani…? [Congregation says, “raMwari."] Ende unogona kunetseka kuzobatsirika hupenyu hwako hwese. Vazhinji vakadzi vanozopedzisira vahedhuka, kana vaapaa ma spirit mediums muhupenyu hwavo; ma secret affairs avanenge va conduct-a nevanhu venyi…? [Congregation says, “venyika."] Ma secret affairs avano conduct-a nevanhu venyika. Mwana waMwari anonamata mirira zuva rako rokuroorwa! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Rinouya chete zuva iro…? [Congregation says, “iroro."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Huh, like a great poet one time who was a sympathizer of polygamy wrote these great words, “there shall be no widows in the land for I’ll marry them all, [Congregation laughs] and there shall be no fatherless orphans because I will father them all.” Hamukuona kutenda kunoita munha waMwari handiti ehe? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] That was a poet handitika. I think he was called Tennyson kuma 15th ce…? [Congregation says, “century."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: He was a sympathizer of polygamy, “the-there will be no widows” zvikanzi, reason of widows in the land handitika it’s mono…? [Congregation says, “monogamy,"] monogamy. If he didn’t preach me-monogamy, there will be no widows in the land because we will-I’ll marry them all. Ha-moona, and there will be no orphans, fatherless one because I’ll father them all ha-moona. Ende ndo policy yedu yatinayo pa…? [Congregation says, “pano."] Hakuna sister vanofa vasina ehh murume mu Church inoparidza ba…? [Congregation says, “barika,"] barika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: No, that’s why you find vana Sister Gwemende vagara vasina varume kwenguva. Reason it’s because ehh matendero edu. As a result, progress yedu yava s-eh-eh retarded. Vanogoroora vakadzi vaviri sei, iye munhu kana pekuisa mukadzi one asi…? [Congregation says, “asina."] Hmm? Kuti uti brother ndiudzei papi, tika-tikabvisa hedu vana takatopinda kare mubarika ka isu. Vana Brother… Chuma varimo kudhara, vana Brother Nehohwa varimo kudhara, ini ndirimo kudhara.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Tikatora zvifana zviripo izvi angaroore ehhh Sr Chipo Chipato ndiani? Patrick angazvigone? [Congregation laughs] Kureba chete ka uku handitika ehe…? [Congregation says, “pasi,”] pasi pane zvaanoziva. 101Zvandiri kukudzidzisai pano kuti unotenga mubhedha wako, base nemattress iye anozvidii? [Congregation says, “anozviziva.”] Kuti kunotengwa masheets, iye anozviziva. Saka unenge wododzidziswa iwewe naChipo kunzi, masheets edu haachakwana. [Apostle Gumbura laughs] Ha-moona kuti manje, saka zvinenge nani zvake Chipo akazvigarira akanamata. Handi muona mamiriro azvinenge zvakaita [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ehe zvotori nani ha-moona. ende vacho ma brother anenge achikwanisa kuti aroore, vari kuto strugg-ula nevava navo ka…? [Congregation says, “kare."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mukanzwa ndichiti vanhu vaMwari ropafadzwai handisi kumbozviitira inini. [Congregation says, “Amen/mmm."] Hatidi kuti… toda kuti paChurch pano paite crisis yevasikana vachipereredza. Kana uchida kuti barika rako riite, unogona kuti mukadzi wako ouya otaura na pastor, woti, ‘ndoda kuti kuuyewo mumwe mukadzi’. Handitika.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Inini ndinoterera izvozvo ndogamuchira handitika. But ndikaona mukadzi iyeye owonda ndoita sei? Achi lo-za weight, achinyepera kusekerera kuti ‘ngavauye vamwe ii ngavauye’. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But kwete kuti, ‘ndoda kuti mainini vangu vauye, ndoda mainini, ndoda mainini kuti vauye.’ Wotarisa mwana, changa chiri chivhindikiti handitika? Chiri kudii…? entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Munhu ngaadzidze kuita honest handitika ehe. zvauri kutaura ngazvienderane nemataridzikiro aunodii…? [Congregation says, “aunoita,"] ehe. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But kana ukaona vanhu vacho, hautombo vaoni pavano pavano jamba jamba kana pavanotamba. Hauvaoni, haa. Hauvaoni pavanojamba jamba. Mumwe munongomuona. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Aah handi ndiro basa revafundisi iroro? Iwe unenge wakatarisa zvako wakamira kudai uchiti, ‘haaa izvi ka izvi hee’. Izvi kwazvava kuda, kwazvava kuda kuenda handi…? entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Pari kufariwa panonzi, ‘ndiri kufara?’ [Congregation says, “mmm-mmm."] Unoona woga. [Congregation says, “kuona."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ukaona Mai Chuma vakauya panapa vachisekerera munhu wese vachimhorosana nevanhu ‘mhoroi, mhoroi…’ woziva kuti… Wotarisa Mai Chuma vadiki. Then kouya vamwe vanenge vakabata ka handbag kavo manje. [Congregation laughs]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Vachisvika kumoto kwese uko. [Apostle Gumbura chuckles] Avo vanosvika kwese, kumoto kwese vanenge vachisvika, vaenda kwana gogo vadzoka vava mu kitchen uko handitika ehe wonya... [Congregation says, “unozviona."] Vakadzi havanetse ku reveal-a kuti hupenyu hausi kutidii…? [Congregation says, “kutiitira,"] hupenyu hausi kutiitira. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Pakatanga kusuwa vakadzi vangu, Mai Tito ava naMai Kim asina kuzviona ndiani? Let’s be honest, pavakanga vari kuKadoma uko hamuna kuzviona mese? Vakaonda ka vanhu ava, zvakaonekwa nemunhu we…? [Congregation says, “wese."] Ndopa ndavatora ndikavaunza panapa ha-moona. Vakapera vese kuonda, kupera vese kupera kuita mabhonzo. Mai… Chionai Mai Tito naMai Kim nhasi mukaona vachifamba apa. Vaingoda kugara padhuze nababa. [Congregation laughs] Takatorapa chirwere ichocho kudha…? [Congregation says, “kudhara,"] kudhara ha-moona ehe.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ukaenda ukanoona iye zvino, right now as we are talking madzimai aGwendere ese ari maviri avo. Havazi kufara here madzimai aya? Madzimai aGwendere aya, haazi kufara? Mukaona Mai Gwendere vakuru kusununguka kwavanga vakaita pa-pa-pa party handitika. Ehe vachibatana nemumwe wavo, vachitova nyorera zvipepa zvekuti endai munotenga zvakati, endai munotenga zvakati. Mhemba iyi ichifara. Unonyatsoziva kuti kumba kuri ri…? [Congregation says, “kuri right,"] kuri right. Kwete kuti Brother Gwendere vouya vondiudza kuti, ‘ehh ndiri kugona barika’. Ndinotarisa mhuri, mhuri inotarisa yo…? Yoga.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Until pavakanga vari mu lounge umu, handi manga muri vaviri mu-mu mu lounge umu. Makasvitsa Shoko here kumunhu waMwari? Makasvitsa? Ehe ndikati o-o vanga vakachena and they were happy. Sister ava vaiita, vaishanda naBrother Chuma ava handitika. Uchinyatsoona kuti mwana akasununguka ari kufara achiseka akaenda kuvana uku akaseka achifara. entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Unenge wakungomakirira munhu, unotaura kuti, ‘ahh brother vakadzi vako hutano kwakanaka vana...? [Congregation says, “nahwo."] Ende pane… patinenge tiri pachechi vari kudii…? [Congregation says, “vari kufara,"] vari kufara.’ Ko ukaona munhu anenge achifamba akadai…? [Apostle Gumbura illustrates and Congregation chuckles] ‘Makadii sister?’ ‘Makadii Pastor?’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Woti, ‘uyu munhu ka uyu ari kutivhara uyu, there is something wrong so…? [Congregation says, “somewhere."] Yeah!’ Iwewe unenge uchitadza kuchi plac-a manje inini handisi munhu wokuti uno… ndinopaparika, I take my time. I’m a really chameleon panyaya dzakafanana nai…? [Congregation says, “naidzodzo,"] naidzodzo. Ndotarisa kuti chii ha-moona, moona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Until ndozoenda manje kuma mothers aya ndoti, ‘imi ma mothers imi ndimi mainditi ohh tarirai mhemba iyi yaifarira barika iyi handiti ko chovaonza chii? Why is she losing wei…? [Congregation says, “weight,"] weight. When she gave us another story just a few weeks a…?” [Congregation says, “ago."] Anokupai story yake akasimba handitika, achingopedza kutaura nyaya yake, muviri wava kudii…? Todzorera here ku New Start Centre? [Apostle Gumbura chuckles]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kuzviona vanhu vaMwari handiti? Ndosaka kana vanhu vachidanana brother, panouya munhu wechitatu iwewe nemukadzi wako iwawo wiriranai! [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha-moona. Unozviona kuti madzimai arikufara aya, ha-moona. Brother Nehohwa mudzimai wavo mukuru akandi text-ira woga zvikanzi, ‘Pastor I’ve been helped greatly’. Vakandinyorera tsa…? [Congregation says, “tsamba."]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: ‘I’ve since changed my being and everything zvekuti ndinotonyara kuti ndaimborwisa.’ Ivo havatombozviziva kuti vakandinyorera tsamba ha-moona hamuzvizive…? Zvikanzi, ‘Pastor mungadei muchifunga kuti ndichiri zvandanga ndiri. I have since changed and I’m asking your prayers kuti ndirambe ndichichinja. Handicharwisa, handichadai handichadai, handichadai, handichadai.’ I never told the brother.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndozvamusingazive vakadzi manje, vakadzi ava vanhu ava, haikona kumumanikidza kuita zvinhu kana kumubata nehungwaru nekuti vanomhan’ara zvokuti dhuu. Ende vano assess-a, ndashama nhasi ndataura naMai Chibvura ava.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: VaChibvura vakandifonera nezuro manheru zvikanzi, ‘mudzimai wangu ahh aita stubborn, andirambira kuti ndamuti udzokere kwaMakoni mangwana’. Akati ‘ndiwe uri kundikonzera kuita stubborn, uri kundidzidzisa stubbornness. Ini handisi kudzokera kwaMakoni ikoko.’ ‘Ndikati sister munoziva zvamuri kutaura here?’ Hanzi ndikanzi, ‘ehe!’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: ‘Saka vati varikuuya kwamuri saka ndangovati endai.’ Hama yandiudza handitika. Saka sister vauya vasvika vagara pano ndikati, ‘ko nhai hanzvadzi zvino zvomoramba kutumwa kwaMakoni.’ Zvikanzi, ‘ahh handina kuramba kutumwa kwaMakoni, kwaMakoni i one hour kuenda, one hour kudzo…? [Congregation says, ‘kudzoka,’] kudzoka netsoka. Saka ndakati kana muchida kuti ndiende kwaMakoni rwendo rwuno, mondisiira mari yechii…? Yebhazi, nekuti kuti ndidzokere futi netsoka uko ndigodzoka.’ Ndikati, ‘hoo?’ Zvikanzi ‘ehe saka ndaizeza kudzokerako because Pastor pane mufambo.’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndikati, ‘horaiti.’ Ndikati, ‘ko zvino nyaya ye stubbornness yamuri kuti, vanondidzidzisa kuita stubborn?’ Zvikanzi, ‘Pastor nyaya inodzokera muchaziva paya patanga kukanganisika munhu waMwari? Waingogara ari mu alter call achingoti, ‘kunamata kana kwakadaiwo unoregera. Kunamata kana kwakadai unoregera’. Zvokuti ndakaa ndofunga kuti, ‘munhu waMwari uyu akuhedhuka ende ada kuhedhuka nesu te…? Ipapo ndopa ndakatanga kuita stubborn ndaaku guard-a nyaya yekudzokera kumai…?’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kuona vanhu vakangwara ka ava…? [Congregation laughs] Ndikati makamboudza here murume wenyu kuti izvozvo maizvi observ-a zvese izvozvo, mmm? Zvikanzi, ‘handina kumbovataurira.’ Ndikati, ndopamava…. endai munogara pasi muvaudze kuti you used to observe all those things,’ ha-maona ehe. Zvikanzi, ‘manje vakazoti mumwe musi wavabva kuMaenga uko. Vakadzoka vakasvi… ‘Ndaperera pano,’ [Congregation laughs] hanzi ‘zvokunamata, ndaperera pano!’ [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Handi muri kuona ehe…? Ma sister anenge aine record aya, vamwe vano observ-a zvisingaite zvekuti ne… Munoziva kuti e-akatanga kugamuchira Message ndiBrother Chibvura, avo avakazonzi huyai kuChurch vachinetswa nemhuri yavo ne family yavo. I was mesmerized ne observation yavo. Vanotoziva nema times acho kuti ‘patakaenda kumuchato waBrother Chigova avo’ ha-moona…? Vakatodzoka kumba vakati, ‘munhu waMwari akundivenga.’ Ndikati, ‘ahh sei?’ Zvikanzi, ‘ndava simudzira ruoko kudai, havana ku respond-a.’ Ini, I don’t remember kureva kuti handina kuzvio…? [Congregation says, “kuzviona”,] handina kuzviona. But ivo va… Zvikanzi, ‘aah’ ha-moona. Vanenge vachi observ-a zvese sister ava. Vachi observ-a ha-maona aihwa.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka ukaona mukadzi akuita stubborn fanga mu Church munomu, haikona kumhanya kunofunga kuti haachade kunamata. Tanga waita self ex…? [Congregation says, “examination.”] Saka ndaichiti kuna Brother Chibvura, ‘Brother Chibvura imbogarai pasi nemhuri yenyu iyi, muva bvunze kuti iyo stubbornness yavari kutsanangura iyi inotangira ku…? [Congregation says, ‘kupi.’] Inotangira kupi, ha-maona?’ Zvinhu zvaanenge anga achi observ-a ha-maona…?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, ‘iye zvino Pastor ndinoda kunamata zvekuti ndinototya kuti stubbornness iyoyo mweya iwoyo.’ Hanzi, ‘ini ndakasvika pandakaoma moyo zvakau-nyanya kunyanya tichitanga kupinda mu Message ndakambokuudzai.’ Ende zveshuwa vakataura. Zvikanzi, ‘takachinja machechi asingapere naBrother zvokuti ndaakuda kuti ndichizorora hangu ndinamate pano.’ Vakauya vakandiona nguva idzodzo ha-moona…? Saka zvikanzi, ‘taka-ti saka inini zvokuchinja machechi handichadii…? Handichadi ini ha-moona…? Saka ndakai ndongonetseka, ndakaoma moyo nguva iyoyo.’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka handimoona kuti hama ndoinofanira kuva ne healing process yainounza kumukadzi wayo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] But she’s more than a willing partner, kuti atungamirirwe nehama iyi. ‘Pastor chindinamatirai. Handidi kuita stubborn kumurume wangu. Zvinongoerekana zvangouya Pastor, zvokuti ndoshaya kuti chii? Ende ndiri kuona ndokwa zviri kubva. Dai ndikanamata, ndikapinda panzvimbo yangu.’ But handi moona kuti kuti ava vanyotsokwana panzimbo yavo, vanofana kutora yavo ndiani…? Hama.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Taizviparidza kubvira kudhara kuti musoro wechitima ukabuda mui…? [Congregation says, “munjanji,"] munjanji. Ma troc anodii…? [Congregation says, “ano turn-a.”] Kazhinji ma troc unozoasiya mudo…? mudondo, ha-maona. Unonyatsoona kuti mwana uyu kunamata a-a arikuda kutodzidzawo, nekudzidziswa nehama.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Now, that’s what all women are like ha-maona but unogona kuva munhu ari intelligent. Some brothers are so intelligent like me, handimunoona kuti ndakangwara chaizvo…? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvekuti you can make a woman do what you want her to do, but not that she wants to do it. Handi muri kuona zvauri kutaura, ehe. You can make her do what you want her to d… or say what you want her to say but not to say she wa…? [Congregation says, “she wants.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Now don’t be that oppressive. Let’s not be that oppressive! Let’s give our wives room, handi tiri kupabata ka varanda vaMwari handiti, [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ngatipei vakadzi vedu room yokuti tifambe navo. Kana uchida kuvaita coerce into something, let’s make them come to a well–informed decision handiti ka…? Rather than kuvaita outwit out of their simplicity, I don’t think that’s fair. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha-moona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Hatitorei vakadzi vedu zvakanaka tichimuvha navo, tichi muvha navo, tichi muvha navo, tichi muvha navo. Now I’ll teach you kuti inini that’s what I’ll do. I’ll give you examples every time when my-my-my life, handi forc-ekedze munhu chinhu. I don’t force anybody, anything. It’s only that now example yandoda kupa it’s not yet mature but it will mature. Ndichaku remind-ai kuti that day ndakakutaurirai kuti example iyi i-it’s in the process, it’s not yet ma…? [Congregation says, “mature.”] Ndotora nguva yangu handi-handi coerc-ese munhu, handi force-ekedze munhu, ndoda kuti munhu aone oga. Akaona oga, munowirirana.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Nyaya yandaakuparidza yema concubines iyi handitika. I was actually forced by situation kuti ndiiparidze iye zvino. This wasn’t the time I wanted to preach it. Ndaida kuvapa…kukuparidza nyaya iyi ndapedza kuva…? [Congregation says, “kuvaka,”] kuvaka panapa. That was my intention, but conditions got out of control. Satan akawana paakapinda nani…? [Congregation says, “napo,”] napo and I had to quickly address the subject or-o zvainetsa vanhu mukuna…? [Congregation says, “mukunamata,”] mukunamata.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then I was forced kuenda kuno i address-a prematurely, I never wanted to ha-maona. But ndaida zvangu ndimboiregera yakadaro, ndoiregera yakadaro, then ndapedza kuvaka panapa zvandiri kuita zvese izvi. I wanted to do these-all these things before tambo mention-a not even one word about concubines ha-maona. But brother chandaakukutaurirai ndechekuti Satan ariko and anorwa. Ende anouya nenzira dzausinga dii…? [Congregation says, “dzausingatarisire.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ndakazoibufura ndaona kuti ehhh, kwandaiswa kwacho kwadii…? Zvino ndorasikirwa nemakwai kwawo, cause any genuine man ka anongonzwisisa kuti wazvidii…? Wazviitirei, you have to go and address a situation. So, I quickly went and addressed that situation not that it was ripe, no! Taida kutovaka Convention Centre. Tipedze kuvaka Convention Centre, ti develop-e kuKadoma. Then totaura nyaya yema concubines.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Maybe, pa 65 years apa ndopanda ndaka target-a inini. I’d given myself 65 years even in prayer kuti Mwari pa 65 years. I never wanted to talk about it now but, you never do what you want. Maybe Mwari vari kuziva kuti handirarame kusvika 65 years idzodzo. Nobody knows ha-maona. Saka unogona kunzi now, itaure izvozvi ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Saka mumwe nemumwe wedu why did I take that long? Ndakabvira… Ndikakutaurirai kuti nyaya yema concubines takaitanga tichitanga kutenga imba kuRedcliff kwa Pastor Chuma. Bvunzai vana Mai… Zane ava nana Mai… Bati handiti…? Ndiani wandaive naye tichitenderera kuRedcliff ndichikuudzai nyaya iyi? Tai… Ndiani aivepo paye? Imimi nani? Paive naMai Tito, Mai Kim nani futi? Who was there? Maive two chete? Ahh, musi uya taive two chete uya, maive two chete?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Iwewe naMai Kim na-na-naMai Tito muri two? Patakatenderera Redcliff iya, tichitaura nyaya iyi, maive two chete? I can’t remember, remember that. But then tapedza ipapo ndakangabvira kuitaura kubvira kare but you see how I’ve kept my promise, I’d never say it. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Ndaivaudza ava kuti, ‘ayihwa, hatina chatati taita. Taparidza barika, barika taparidza but taparidza barika, pa… rinoita complete kana taparidza nyaya yemai…?’ [Congregation says, “concubines.”] ‘Ko munodii kuiparidza?’

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: I’d tell them my reasons, this is this reason, this is the reason. ‘Chechi haizi ready tarirai hondo yatinayo pabarika.’ But muri kuona kuti iye zvino barika tanga takurihwina? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pakapinda vana Jeremiah mu-k-mumu scandal idzi, vana Mpofu mu scandal idzi tanga tangosara ne one bastion of resistance, yaVaChitsinde ndobva kwapinda nyaya dzema ferti-raiza idzi. Saka muri kuona tatahwina? [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Saka ndopatati taidei takuisa chapter iyi kumasu…? [Congregation says, “kumashure,”] tomuvha ku next cha…? [Congregation says, “chapter.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Unomirira Mwari, Mwari kuti vazarure mukana! [Congregation says, “Amen,”] ha-maona. I wanted my wives to accept it bit by bit, bit by bit, bit by bit, bit by bit, but vakanga vaigamuchira here madzimai angu? As mmm… ehh… ndavaudza background vese vana Mai Zane vanozviziva ndichivatsanangurira background iyi. But patakauya panapa, tava panapa paaa Marlborough panapa you could see kuti they are still resisting nyaya yema co…? They didn’t want. Zvakuita sekuti uri kutova dzidziso ipapo but wanga uchizvitaura all the…? They didn’t want!

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Vese vana Amanda vanga vasingade they were not ready for it. Vese vana Mai Tito vanga vasingadi. Vese vana Mother ava vanga vasingadi. Wotoona but I have spoken for over five years they are not ready. But ukazviita manje munhu pfungwa yake yagamuchira handiti…? Anotadza kunamata? Anouya mu Church akafara maona. Ndosaka ndikaku… mu-mu-mukaona haikona ku force-ekedza mudzimai kugamuchira zvinhu zvaasingadi, it’s not a solution ha-maona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende haikona kumhanya kungonoroora, kuroora it’s not a so…? [Congregation says, “solution.”] Ehe, ende kana uri mwana muduku very dangerous kuti kana uri mupfanha ari below thirty years upinde mubarika kazhinji.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: You have to be very careful because vapfanha vane tendency yekuti vakarara nevasikana, mukuona problem ine vapfanha? Akarara nevasikana anofinhiwa nani…? Vapfanha vanofinihwa nevakadzi. Akarara naye two-three times, haachamuda aakuda chii…? Aakuda mumwe. Oenda kune mumwe two-three times, haachamuda. Haazive kunonzi kugara nemukadzi. Anokurumidza kurakwa, kudhinhiwa, pride, immaturity.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvemunhu anopisa dura munguva yemaguta asingazive kuti drought iriko gore rinodii…? [Congregation laughs and says, “rinotevera.”] Ndozviri vapfanha vazhi…? [Congregation says, “vazhinji.”] Ehe, ndosaka muchiona vapfanha anonyenga musikana nhasi, ku-ku-ku-ku-ku kuHatfield. Odanana naye three-four months, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] osiya. Aanomumwe kuHigh-firidzi, odanana naye three-four months, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] osiya. Aanomumwe kunhingi, eh ku-ku-ku-ku-ku kuMebhoraini three-four months, [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once] osiya.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Mweya wekuti munhu unorara nemusikana womusema, mweya waAmnon. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] That is not Biblical! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Murau wekuna Deuteronomy, waiti munhu kana ukabata musikana mhandara handiti ka…? Ukaiii deflower mhandara iyoyo unofanira kubhadhara mubereki wake how many…? [Congregation says, “50 shekels,”] and haufanire kumura…? [Congregation says, “kumuramba/kumurasa.”] Saka musikana wese murume aimu deflower equals to marriage. Munhu aku deflower equals to marriage ndoMurau waani iwoyo…? [Congregation says, “waMwari.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Is that what is there now? No! They deflower ha-maona, you deflower a virgin handitika. Wokaramba kasikana kaya kaya apa, wakadzidzisa varume, handitika. Kachagona here kurarama kasina? Kakunotorwa nemu….? Uya uya mumwe okadii futi, okasiya. Konotorwa futi nemu…? Uya mumwe futi okadii…? Until the woman becomes a woman without shame, haa. Any woman who undresses before ten men achafa akanyara…? Ten men, uchanyarei haa?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Kuona musikana achifamba akashama kubva pano kuenda kunotora bhurukwa rake raasiya uko, haa. Opfeka ikoko odzoka, ouya otora hembe yakandwa uko handitika, odzoka pana aMarange handitika. Svondo inouya ari kuita the same kunaani…? Kuna Edgar handitika. Svondo inouya ari kuita the same kuna VaMukodzi. Svondo inouya ari kuita the same kuna Silas. Waona Svondo inouya ari kuna Chibvura, Svondo inouya ari kuna VaKakunga ha-moona. Inotevera yacho ari kuneni, haa mu-mukanyatsotaura naye zvakanaka muchimu nyengetedza kuti mira apo wakashama anodii…? [Congregation says, “anomira,”] anomira. [Apostle Gumbura claps hands once. Congregation laughs]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ahh wavindisa ka uyu handitika ehe, ehe mukati chiuya umire panapa chingomira chete haa iye zvino hauzi kudii…? Hauna zvauri kuitwa, toda kuti Ungomira chete. Ndosaka uchiona vasikana vachibuda pa front page ye magazine, those are not virgins. Kuchitariswa nenyika yose akashama hazvimunetse because she has undressed to so ma…? [Congregation says, “so many,”] so many. Over twenty, over forty men, what difference does it make mmm?

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: But mhandara brother, kuii-kuikururusa kuti bvisa hembe chete hembe/ munonetsana. Bvisa hembe tione wanzwa, ‘handidi, handidi, handidi, handidi, handidi’ chibvisa to… ‘handidi, handidi’ hee. Moita zvekuto bvarurirana handitika but kana aziva manje, akabva apa, akabva apa, akabva apa, akabva apa. Kanouya panapa tanana. Ndosaka mukaona manje tuzhinji twacho tu-tu-tu tuma hure utwu tunopfeka mini inosvika uko, half pant kadrezi kachitangira apa ma bum ese ari pai…? Panze, kongoperera panapa guvhu riri pai…? [Congregation says, “panze.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ka body top kanoperera apa, mazamu ese ari pai…? panze. Musana uri panze ende kagorova high hiri irefu kudaiwo kuti tee tee Harare yose ichidii…? Vari mumota vanenge vachicheuka, bhe-pee bhe- bhe ma-va Pedestrian mbee, vemabhasikoro nde-nde-nde. [Apostle Gumbura and Congregation laugh] Kuratidza kuti mwana uyu zvaaita handi…? [Congregation says, “handizvo.”] Vanhu tatojaira iye zvino ne society yatiri kugara mai…? [Congregation says, “mairi,”] ha-maona. But isusu panapa we are believers in Divine Marriage. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Prostitution hatidi zvacho…? [Congregation says, “zvachose.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ehe, Mwari vanofanira kuti daira nekuti ropafadza ha-maona right, ma brother edu ngaachiropafadzwa ka aite mari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende gona kuchengeta mukadzi wawui...? [Congregation says, “wauinaye.”] Ndinoona vakadzi vaunavo, haikona kumbozvinetsa nekuuya kuzondiudza kuti ndoda kuroora mukadzi wechipiri, ndoda kuroora mukadzi wechitatu. Gona pane wekudii iyeye…? [Congregation says, “wekutanga.”] Mmm, toda kumuona aine majuzi ake maviri, mabhachi woitawo mangani, maviri. Bhutsu dake oitawo ngani, mbiri handimunoona zvinoita munhu ehe, madre-zi ake oitawo kana kuti matatu.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Zvino ukaona mukadzi handitika. Aine tudrezi twenha…? [Congregation says, “twenhamo.”] Tumajuzi twei…? Tumabachi twei…? Baba vacho voti ndoda kuwedzera, iwe uri Pastor, does that make sense? [Congregation says, “no.”] Ngatione mukadzi wako zvaanenge akarova nhasi. Nhasi akarova mink coat yake yaasonesa. Ahh, mangwana ari mu outfit-i inoyi. Ahh, mangwana ane kabhutsu kakati rebererei, mangwana ane kamwe kaflat. Nhasi ane human hair yeblack mangwana ane tsvuku handitika, ehe? Nhasi ane kabhachi kake ke purple, mangwana ane kamwe ke katema ehka waona arova kajuzi kake handimunoona.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ende mukadzi anobatwa zvakanaka ane confidence. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tingaita Amen akadarika Amen here? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Waona mukadzi ane confidence achifamba apa, brother vouya voti taurai na sister, hUh. Don’t send skeletons to talk to me! [Congregation laughs]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ha-maona. If she’s a skeleton I don’t want to talk to her. Ndopa ndakamuudza kuti, ‘iwe, iwe zvawakawonda kudai chiri kukuonza chii? Sadza muna…? [Congregation says, “munaro,”] munaro, imba muna…? [Congregation says, “munayo,”] mota muna…? [Congregation says, “munayo.”] Uri kuonda nei?’ Ngaatsanangure chiri kumuonza. Kana mukadzi aakufara haubvunze, face inotaura yo…? [Congregation says, “yoga.”] Unoona achisekerera kudai achiita confidence kudai akadai, hembe yakafita yakabata zvakanaka naka. Waona achifamba apa. And the one who gives the confidence is you, my brother. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Nhasi zuva redu reChishanu iri, rataka… dedi-keta [dedicate-ED] kustatus, ini handizi kuzogutsikana kusvika ndaona status yevanhu vari kutsanya ndichiparidzira every day, yasanduka! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aihwa ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akapfuura ipapo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mari yavapo, pfuma yadii…? [Congregation says, “yavapo.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Tovaka chechi dzedu panapa toda kuva vanhu… Iye zvino ndaita kana tikadai, nzvimbo ino taigadzira zvakanaka, it will be senseless to destroy a place like this. So, what are we going to do? In the event yekuti tapuhwa license yedu, we let this one be a boardroom, tongoiregera yakadii…? [Congregation says, “yakadaro.”] Or-o ma small practice anenge achiita evanhu e birthday, vana whatever, whatever they want to do.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Then tovaka imwe kuseri uko, yekupinda from Monday to Fri…? [Congregation says, “Friday.] Then kana tava nema conventions tovaka zi…ratinozendemura kusvika uko. Ratinovaka uko tinokwana tese Monday to Friday neSunday, inouya vanhu vekuGweru kana vekuKwekwe handitika. [Congregation says, “mmm.”] Then kana tava nema combined meeting ko convention yedu yatinodaidza nediaspora toenda pane bigger church. Space tina…? [Congregation says, “tinayo.”] Jahwi ha-maona. Toda kunamatira mari yekuvaka! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda mari yokudii…? [Congregation says, “yekuvaka.”] Ehh toda mari yekuvaka. 157Vanhu vaMwari kana muchiita wear off mumunamato, isu tisati tawana mhinduro kudai. Iwewo hunhu hwako chaihwo husati hwachinja. Tiri kutanga neku status yako. Tiri kutanga nokudzinga poverty mauri. Tiri kutanga nekutsi-dzinga mweya yemai…? [Congregation says, “yemadzinza,”] madzinza. Ende as far as polygamy is concerned it’s a forgone conclusion, we are a polygamous Church! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We believe in Divine Ma…? [Congregation says, “Marriage.”] But hatidi manje poverty, handidi munhu ano strugg-ula pa Divine Marriage, no! Saka ma brother angu ngaasimudzirwe kuta…? [Congregation says, “kutanga,”] zviri zvimajaya.

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Ngaasimudzirwe even nekurima. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe ngaasimudzirwei even nezvimwe zvinhu zvese zvakawanda wanda. Ngatiitei mari pakati pedu yokuti kunyangwe iwewe ukasasimudzirwa uri individual, mari ngaiwande pano zvokuti hapana anotambura [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndopfungwa yatiinayo! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tovaka panapa. Honai ini ndakakumbira kuti Mwari ngatinamatei handitika. Mwari vakafara sterek nenyaya yedu yokunamata neChishanu. Tarirai progress yatiri kuita pano. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Are we making progress? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: Conditions for Restoration of Blessings (Part 1)
entries.text: Moziva takatanga kuvaka zvese zvatiri kuvaka izvi, munaaa muna March. Vana vangu vachivhara chikoro vachienda kuma holidays. Ndichiti ndoda kuti vadzoke ku second term tapedza kuvawedzerera two rooms dzokurara, muchaziva? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vakadzoka second term yacho uku two rooms dzisati tadii…? tapedza.
